title: Pipeline · Runs
description: Every run of every pipeline, from the event log (serving.run_events: one Delta event log per dataset, read in place).

list.name: dataset
list.label: Dataset
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT dataset FROM serving.run_events ORDER BY dataset
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT dataset FROM serving.run_events ORDER BY dataset

target.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, ended_at AS timeEnd, concat(dataset, ' · ', lower(status), ' · ', trigger) AS text FROM serving.run_events WHERE event_type = 'run' AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Runs started in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, dataset,
           anyIf(e.partition, e.event_type = 'run') AS run_partition,
           anyIf(e.trigger, e.event_type = 'run') AS run_trigger,
           minIf(e.started_at, e.event_type = 'run') AS started,
           maxIf(e.ended_at, e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')) AS ended,
           multiIf(run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM serving.run_verdicts FINAL WHERE status = 'FAILED'), 'FAILED',
                   run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM serving.run_verdicts FINAL WHERE status = 'CANCELED'), 'CANCELED',
                   countIf(e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status = 'FAILED') > 0, 'FAILED',
                   countIf(e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status = 'COMPLETED') > 0, 'COMPLETED',
                   max(e.ts) < now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR, 'STALLED', 'RUNNING') AS outcome,
           sumIf(e.rows_out, e.event_type = 'flow_progress' AND e.flow = 'bronze') AS ingested_rows,
           sumIf(e.rows_dropped, e.event_type = 'flow_progress' AND e.flow = 'silver') AS quarantined,
           sumIf(e.rows_out, e.event_type = 'flow_progress' AND e.flow = 'history') AS merged
    FROM serving.run_events AS e
    WHERE e.dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote})
    GROUP BY run_id, dataset
) SELECT count() FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started)

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Every run in the range, newest first. Click a run id for its flows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, dataset,
           anyIf(e.partition, e.event_type = 'run') AS run_partition,
           anyIf(e.trigger, e.event_type = 'run') AS run_trigger,
           minIf(e.started_at, e.event_type = 'run') AS started,
           maxIf(e.ended_at, e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')) AS ended,
           multiIf(run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM serving.run_verdicts FINAL WHERE status = 'FAILED'), 'FAILED',
                   run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM serving.run_verdicts FINAL WHERE status = 'CANCELED'), 'CANCELED',
                   countIf(e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status = 'FAILED') > 0, 'FAILED',
                   countIf(e.event_type = 'run' AND e.status = 'COMPLETED') > 0, 'COMPLETED',
                   max(e.ts) < now() - INTERVAL 2 HOUR, 'STALLED', 'RUNNING') AS outcome,

    FROM serving.run_events AS e

panels.title: Last completed run per dataset
panels.description: When each dataset last completed a run. Scheduled pipelines should stay under their schedule interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, max(ended_at) AS last_completed, dateDiff('minute', max(ended_at), now()) AS minutes_ago, argMax(trigger, ended_at) AS trigger FROM serving.run_events WHERE event_type = 'run' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND run_id NOT IN (SELECT run_id FROM serving.run_verdicts FINAL) AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote}) GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset

panels.title: Average flow time
panels.description: Where a run spends its time, averaged over the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT flow, round(avg(dateDiff('millisecond', started_at, ended_at)) / 1000, 2) AS seconds FROM serving.run_events WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND dataset IN (${dataset:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY flow ORDER BY seconds DESC
